properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 25 at 1:12PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
At 111 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 18
miles northwest of Nucla, or 24 miles east of La Sal, moving
southeast at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Uravan.

This includes Colorado 141 between mile markers 73 and 93.
